title: Historical PBS ATC2 teaching dataset, July 1991 to June 2008
attribution: Medicare Australia (original statistics); Mitchell O’Hara-Wild, Rob Hyndman, Earo Wang and Rakshitha Godahewa (tsibbledata); Mitchell O’Hara-Wild (R/Medicine 2024 workshop CSV).
licensing_scope: Both upstream declarations retained; neither is replaced by project Apache-2.0. Maintainer approved archiving with both notices on 6 November 2026. No assertion that the workshop relabels upstream rights.
source_transformations: missing month/key combinations filled with Scripts=0 and Cost=0 by upstream fill_gaps
zero_caveat: Upstream fill_gaps(Scripts=0, Cost=0) inserts zero-valued missing month/key combinations. Zeros are source-transformation output, not independent evidence of zero utilisation. GMA preserves CSV bytes unchanged.
limitations: Transformed teaching data; not a native untouched Medicare export.
Does not replace AIHW ATC2 monthly 2015-onward age/LGA rates.
Archival inclusion is not semantic admission or clinical qualification.
privacy: Public aggregate sources only; no participant, cohort-derived or OneDrive inputs.
